name: Jude
section: New Testament: General Letters and Revelation
author: Jude, who calls himself a brother of James.
setting: Written to warn against false teachers.
theme: Defend the faith once delivered and keep yourselves in God’s love.

outline.label: Build yourselves up and show mercy

christInBook: Jude calls Jesus Christ our only Master and Lord (v. 4) and ends by pointing to the one who is able to keep us from stumbling and present us blameless with great joy (v. 24).
howToRead: Jude is a short, urgent letter. Notice the many examples from Scripture and Jewish tradition, and the call to build yourself up and keep yourself in the love of God.
